# Theme reference

Themes are style-only presets. They change type, spacing, radius, shadow, buttons, cards and which brand color roles are used, never colors, fonts or logos. See [Themes](themes-guide.md) for how they work and how to add one.

| Theme | Mood | Default variants and settings |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `black-friday` | Maximum urgency: shouty uppercase display type, hard square edges, thick black rules and the warning color as the highlight. | `promotional/discount-banner` &rarr; dark, `promotional/urgency-banner` &rarr; dark, `promotional/last-chance` &rarr; urgent, `decorative/badge` &rarr; urgent |
| `bold` | Loud and confident: heavy uppercase headlines, chunky square buttons, thick rules and high contrast. | none |
| `christmas` | Festive: red and green from the brand roles for accents, rounded pill buttons, dashed and dotted ornament. | `decorative/line`, `decorative/badge` &rarr; pill |
| `ecommerce` | Built to sell: clear prices, strong sale color, compact spacing, solid buttons and subtle card shadows. | none |
| `editorial` | Magazine-like: large confident headlines, generous reading sizes, strong rules and square edges. | `commerce/product-card` &rarr; editorial, `commerce/product-grid` &rarr; editorial |
| `fashion` | High-contrast and runway-minimal: spaced uppercase labels, light display type, sharp edges and bare backgrounds. | `commerce/product-card` &rarr; luxury, `commerce/product-grid` &rarr; editorial |
| `luxury` | Quiet and expensive: thin uppercase type with wide tracking, square corners, hairlines and lots of white space. | `commerce/product-card` &rarr; luxury, `commerce/product-grid` &rarr; luxury, `decorative/badge` &rarr; outline |
| `minimal` | Neutral and quiet. Square-ish corners, hairline borders, no shadows, generous whitespace. The reference theme and the default. | none |
| `playful` | Friendly and bouncy: big rounded corners, pill buttons, soft shadows and chunky headings. | `commerce/product-card` &rarr; playful, `commerce/product-grid` &rarr; playful, `decorative/badge` &rarr; pill |
| `saas` | Clean product marketing: tight, modern type, medium radii, hairline cards with a whisper of shadow. | `decorative/badge` &rarr; pill |
| `summer` | Bright and easygoing: heavy friendly headings, airy spacing, big rounded corners and a sun-colored accent. | `commerce/product-card` &rarr; playful, `commerce/product-grid` &rarr; playful, `decorative/badge` &rarr; pill |
| `valentines` | Romantic: soft rounded shapes, light headings, pill buttons and accent-colored hairlines and dot ornaments. | `decorative/line` &rarr; ornament, `decorative/badge` &rarr; pill |
| `wellness` | Calm and soft: light headings, relaxed line height, generous space, rounded corners and no shadows. | `commerce/product-grid` &rarr; minimal |
